properties.description: Transform and array of files into a STAC
properties.name: 2stac2
properties.cwl:
cwlVersion: v1.2
$namespaces:
  s: https://schema.org/
  edam: http://edamontology.org/
$graph:
- class: CommandLineTool
  id: 2stac2
  baseCommand: python
  arguments:
  - /opt/2stac2.py
  - valueFrom: '$( function () { var files_array = [];

      Object.keys(inputs).forEach(element => { if(element != ''metadata'') { files_array.push(''--file'');
      files_array.push(inputs[element]); } else { files_array.push(''--metadata'');
      files_array.push(inputs[element]); } });

      return files_array; }())'
  inputs:
    file_1:
      doc: file 1
      type: File
    file_2:
      doc: file 2
      type: File?
    metadata:
      format: edam:format_3464
      doc: metadata file
      type: File
  outputs:
    stac_result:
      outputBinding:
        glob: stac_result
      type: Directory
  requirements:
    EnvVarRequirement:
      envDef:
        PATH: /opt/conda/envs/application/bin:/opt/conda/condabin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
    ResourceRequirement: {}
    InlineJavascriptRequirement: {}
    DockerRequirement:
      dockerPull: iliad-repository.inesctec.pt/2stac2:0.3.1
  s:name: 2stac2
  s:softwareVersion: 0.3.1
  s:description: Transform and array of files into a STAC
  s:keywords:
  - stac
  - metadata
  s:programmingLanguage: python
  s:producer:
    class: s:Organization
    s:name: INESCTEC
    s:url: https://inesctec.pt
    s:address:
      class: s:PostalAddress
      s:addressCountry: PT
  s:sourceOrganization:
  - class: s:Organization
    s:name: INESCTEC
    s:url: https://inesctec.pt
    s:address:
      class: s:PostalAddress
      s:addressCountry: PT
  s:author:
  - class: s:Person
    s:name: Miguel Correia
    s:email: miguel.r.correia@inesctec.pt
  s:dateCreated: '2026-01-27T16:00:40Z'
  s:identifier: urn:apkg:tool:inesctec:pt:2stac2:0.3.1
  s:sdDatePublished: '2026-01-27T16:04:24.615070Z'
  s:sdPublisher:
    class: Organization
    name: Application Package Registry
    url: https://iliad-registry.inesctec.pt
